=== MEASUREMENT-GUIDED NEXT DIAGNOSTIC ===
No event overlap + high blue_other => profile update attachment/stage; do not assert GC.
High geometry and exact-query counts => geometry workload branch.
High predictor and RHS/rejections => investigate native numerical workload.
High trigger_outer with low prediction and geometry => MATLAB trigger wrapper/event.

NEXT_ACTION: correlate high geometry_ms with exact query counts; high predictor_ms with RHS/rejected; high update-minus-trigger with stage detail and detection/memory transitions.
If all stage fields are absent, rerun with setenv('REPLANNING_STAGE_TIMING','1') before Flight construction.
